task.title: Fill an existing recipe from a web link
task.description:
Reported from phone testing on the dev site (2026-11-18).

Seen:
- A recipe created by name only (Add manually, or typed into a planner Cook slot) cannot later be filled from a link. Example: create 'Shrimp Peperonata' with nothing in it, then want to paste the New York Times link into it.
- The link can only go through Import recipe, which makes a second recipe with the same name; the planner slot keeps pointing at the empty one.

Wanted:
- On an existing recipe you own, an 'Import from link' action (recipe page and edit form) that runs the normal import with preview and, on confirm, fills that same recipe: ingredients, instructions, times, servings, image, source link.
- Planner slots already pointing at the recipe keep pointing at it and pick up the details.
- If the recipe already has ingredients or instructions, warn before replacing them.
- Needs the user's AI key, with the same missing-key message as other imports.

Notes:
- Today a pasted link in an empty planner slot does start an import (convex/planner.ts importLink / startSlotImport), but there is no path for a slot that already holds a typed name, and none on the recipe page.
- Import currently always inserts a new recipe (convex/recipeIngestion.ts); this needs a target-recipe option on the import record.
- Related: 'Planner Cook slot: pick the right recipe instead of silently creating one' and 'Recipe removal can't be found on a phone'.
